question: What claim is made about the total field-group with respect to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: A total field-group belonging to them is posited.
inference: The teaching posits a complete field-group that pertains to the totality of earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The internal structure of that field-group is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: The all-field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
